digestDefinition: sourceIssueBearingBlocksSha256 hashes canonical JSON of blocks; sourceDomIssueParagraphsSha256 hashes JSON.stringify of the 14 rendered Issues/Collects/OGN paragraphs with nonbreaking spaces normalized to spaces.
sourceBoundary: The exact best-of page from Origin of Ultron through Latest Additions: 14 Issues/Collects/OGN blocks plus the explicitly named Annihilation: Conquest one-shot prologue and Nova #4-7. Keep source order, including the prologue after the main Conquest range. No linked-guide expansion, inferred unnumbered runs, narrative or artwork. Ultron Revolution is an animated-continuity selection.
excludedSourceReferences: Annihilation: Conquest tie-ins starring Starlord, Wraith and Someone: unnumbered recommendations do not define issue runs; no linked-series expansion.
Age of Ultron!: the page links a full event guide but enumerates no issue range here; no recursive guide expansion.
Runaways: the bonus recommendation enumerates no issues; no inferred 2003 run or trade contents.
Avengers Forever: contextual comparison, not an issue-bearing selection.
Contextual repeated mentions of Avengers #54 and #58 explain the already enumerated Origin range; they are commentary, not additional sequence positions.
